sentences.text: On perusal of the records, this Court is of the opinion that the documents produced by the appellant requires to be considered by the Tribunal.

Hence, this Court finds it just and reasonable to remand the matter to the concerned Tribunal, in order to provide an opportunity to both parties to adduce evidence for the purpose of marking the said documents and advance arguments on merits.

Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed.
ii) The matter is remanded to the concerned Tribunal with a direction to give opportunity to both parties to adduce evidence and advance arguments.
NC: 2025:KHC:35357 HC-KAR iii) The Tribunal shall dispose of the matter on merits within a period of three months from the date of receipt of record.
iv) Registry is directed to send back the Trial Court records to the concerned Tribunal immediately.
v) The parties are directed to appear before the concerned Tribunal on 08.10.2025 without awaiting further notice.
